summary.text: Bryan Hughes is a Republican state senator from Texas Senate District 1 who has served since January 10, 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Laticia Ambroz is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Bryan Hughes has a private law practice in Mineola and previously worked as a briefing attorney for U.S. District Judge William M. Steger, according to Ballotpedia.

He serves on the board of trustees of the Steward's Foundation and is a member of the Golden Bible Chapel, the Mineola Foundation Board, the National Rifle Association, the Red Cross and the Rotary Club of Mineola.
Ballotpedia lists earlier Texas House committee assignments for Hughes, including Agriculture and Livestock and Human Services in 2011-2012.
He assumed office in the Texas Senate on January 10, 2017.

For 2023-2024 he chaired the Jurisprudence and State Affairs committees and was also assigned to the Finance, Health & Human Services, Natural Resources and Economic Development, and Nominations committees.
